CommunityApplications.Profile: minstrel-launchpad lets the Minstrel music app reach the UPnP/DLNA media servers on your home network when you are not at home, over a pinned TLS connection that only devices you have paired can use. One small Go binary, no account, nothing sent anywhere else. The image here is the one built from each release tag of the project below, and support happens in the Unraid thread linked on the application.
